{{RaceIcon|SpawnGreen|Male}}{{RaceIcon|SpawnGreen|Female}} [[Green dragonspawn]] |boss={{RaceIcon|DragonGreen}} [[Solnius]] |level=60 |minlevel=60 |players=40 |key=[[Gemstone of Ysera]] |bosses={{Emerald Sanctum}} }} '''Emerald Sanctum''' is an instance raid located in [[Hyjal]]. A fog of corruption has descended upon the Emerald Dream, twisting the morals and intentions of even the noblest and purest. The corrupted Wakener is preparing to send a premature call of awakening; if not stopped, his kin will arise and go on a frenzied rampage across Azeroth. ==Geography== WorldMap-EmeraldSanctum.jpg ==Attunement== In order enter the instance portal of the Emerald Sanctum, the player needs to have the [[Gemstone of Ysera]], which can be acquired through the quest chain "Into the Dream": *[[Into the Dream I]] **Starts and ends at [[Ralathius]] in [[Nordanaar]], [[Hyjal]] **Simply listen to Ralathius' story *[[Into the Dream II]] **Starts and ends at [[Ralathius]] in [[Nordanaar]], [[Hyjal]] **Collect 3 [[Nightmare Effigy|Nightmare Effigies]] from the Satyrs in Hyjal *[[Into the Dream III]] **Starts at [[Ralathius]] in [[Nordanaar]], [[Hyjal]] **Ends at [[Itharius]] in the [[Swamp of Sorrows]] **Collect the following: ***An [[Overloaded Arcane Prism]] (from an [[Arcane Torrent]] in [[Dire Maul]] West) ***A [[Slumberer's Shard]] (from [[Weaver]] in [[Sunken Temple]]) ***A [[Binding Fragment]] (from an elite [[Cliff Breaker]] giant in [[Azshara]]) ***An [[Arcanite Rod]] (made by [[Blackmithing|blacksmiths]] or purchasable for 150 gold from [[Vorthos Everbreeze]] in Nordanaar) *[[Into the Dream IV]] **Starts at [[Itharius]] in the [[Swamp of Sorrows]] **Ends at [[Ralathius]] in [[Nordanaar]], [[Hyjal]] **Simply travel back to Ralathius *[[Into the Dream V]] **Starts and ends at [[Ralathius]] in [[Nordanaar]], [[Hyjal]] **Protect Ralathius during the short event against 4 [[Nightmare Apparition]]s (non-elite) *[[Into the Dream VI]] **Starts and ends at [[Ralathius]] in [[Nordanaar]], [[Hyjal]] **Loot the [[Charge of Ysera]] from the drake [[Larannikus]] (level 61 elite, CC-immune) in [[Hyjal]] ==Patch changes== * [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] '''[[Patch 1.17.0]] (2023-10-03):''' Added.
